teachingQuestion: Where do cloud-native deployments concentrate security authority?
focalInsight: The provider-customer boundary and the customer deployment, orchestration, workload-identity, API, and data paths must each have an explicit owner and control evidence.
title: Cloud-native control paths cross more than the request path
caption: Protect the data flow and the control plane that can change every workload in that flow.
altSummary: A cloud-native workflow has an external request path to an API, workload, and data service, plus a high-impact deployment and orchestration control plane operated across a defined provider-customer responsibility boundary.
textFallback: Validate and authorize requests at the API or event ingress. Run functions and containers with scoped workload identities. Authorize data access by action and object. Protect the deployment pipeline, image registry, configuration, and orchestration control plane because they can change many workloads. Document which provider and customer controls apply at each service layer.
